summary_en: S&B Foods executed a fixed-price purchase of up to 300,000 shares (1.24% of outstanding shares) via ToSTNeT-3 at 7,320 yen per share on November 13, 2026, with a maximum acquisition cost of 2.196 billion yen. All purchased shares will be cancelled on November 26, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading System (ToSTNeT-3) and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, S&B Foods' Board of Directors resolved to acquire and cancel treasury stock. The company executed the purchase on November 13, 2026, via the Tokyo Stock Exchange's off-hours trading system (ToSTNeT-3) at a fixed price of 7,320 yen per share, which was the closing price on November 12. The acquisition targeted up to 300,000 shares with a maximum outlay of 2.196 billion yen, representing 1.24% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).

The purchase was conducted through a single off-hours trading session on November 13 at 8:45 a.m., with buy orders matched against sell orders at the fixed price. The trading order was valid only during that specific session. All shares acquired through this execution will be cancelled on November 26, 2026.

The company cited capital efficiency improvement and enhanced shareholder returns as the reasons for this capital allocation. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 3,062,482 treasury shares against 27,244,468 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
